target.title: fix(matrix): handle stdout/stderr stream errors in dependency commands
target.body:
## Summary

- add stdout/stderr `error` handlers to Matrix dependency bootstrap commands
- reuse the existing finalize path with a failed command result and terminate the child process on stream failure
- cover stdout and stderr stream errors with a focused regression test
- collision check: no open PR found for the Matrix dependency command stream-error issue or `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/deps.ts`; the only fuzzy search hit was an unrelated Telegram PR

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-matrix.config.ts extensions/matrix/src/matrix/deps.test.ts -t "runFixedCommandWithTimeout"` — passed; 1 file, 2 tests passed, 8 skipped

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Matrix dependency bootstrap commands collected child stdout/stderr `data` but did not handle readable stream `error`, so a stream `EPIPE` could bypass the command result handling.
Real environment tested: mocked dependency command child processes using Node `PassThrough` streams in Vitest; no real Matrix SDK download was required.
Exact steps or command run after this patch: emitted `error` on mocked stdout and stderr streams while `runFixedCommandWithTimeout` was awaiting command completion.
Evidence after fix: each emitted stream error did not throw out of band, killed the child process with `SIGTERM`, and resolved to `{ code: 1, stdout: "", stderr: "stdout stream failed: EPIPE" }` or the stderr equivalent.
Observed result after fix: dependency command stream failures now return a bounded command failure result instead of becoming unhandled stream errors.
What was not tested: full CI and a live Matrix crypto runtime bootstrap download.
